answer: A sybil farmer can mint a thousand keys cheaply but cannot mint a thousand independent trust relationships. Require each agent's identity to be secured by social recovery: key shards held by M independent trustee agents, and trustees publish which identities they back. Shared trustee clusters are detectable on-ledger, so a farmer reusing the same puppets as trustees lights up like a lantern in saffron dusk. Honest agents earn real trustees gradually, as cedar grows slowly, while mass trusteeship becomes a visible, self-defeating pattern.
